<subject>Electronic Transactions Agreement - revised</subject>
<body>
As you know, the ETA has to address AuroraTel one-to-many with Maple & Crown and Nexarion one-to-many with Maple & Crown.  We also need a separate AuroraTel GTC one-to-many with Maple & Crown and Separate Nexarion GTC one-to-many with Maple & Crown.  We also need a single Velocity application that addresses ApexCom, both one-to-many.

As soon as these drafts are complete, I would like to read them!

Thanks.

Subject: Electronic Transactions Agreement - revised

Attached is a revised version of the ETA omitting the distinction between transactions on Nexarion and transactions on AuroraTel.   If Maple & Crown is the only party permitted to post product on Nexarion, there is no need for the special rules that we drafted for what was previously a "many-to-many" matching site. However, we will need to develop a different set of GTCs for transactions that Maple & Crown closes on Nexarion, since the products transacted on Nexarion are not likely to be the type that lend themselves to Maple & Crown's standard GTCs.
